AI Notes.value: Jenny Sabin Studio is an experimental architecture and design practice founded by Jenny Sabin (b. 1974), based in Ithaca, NY. Sabin holds a MArch from UPenn (2005) and has been Arthur L. and Isabel B. Wiesenberger Professor of Architecture at Cornell AAP since 2011, where she directs the Sabin Design Lab and chairs the new Dept. of Design Tech. Principal investigator level; senior academic and practitioner with 20+ years of experience. Studio has 6 current team members (architects, designers, engineers). Key projects: Lumen (MoMA PS1 YAP, 2017), Ada (Microsoft, 2019), SinewFlex (Nike, 2020), PolyForm (Cornell, 2021), Bolt Tower (Oklahoma City, 2026). Work in permanent collections at Centre Pompidou, FRAC Centre, Cooper Hewitt. Awards include Pew Fellowship (2010), USA Knight Fellowship (2011), Architectural League Prize (2014/15).
